data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; ward-level aggregates, no patient data or patient identifiers

grains.RAW.WARD_DAILY: one row per ward per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.EQUIPMENT_FLEET: one row per ward (bedside equipment snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day FORECAST of admissions; boarding-time ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.WARD_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic bed-flow SOPs (one per ward type and pressure driver)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.HOSPITAL_CAPACITY_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.HOSPITAL_CAPACITY_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, ward, pressure-driver and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (wards, daily admissions and escalations, confirmed capacity overflows by ward, overflow risk, census events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_CENSUS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_CENSUS_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.overflow_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed capacity overflow in next 7 days) per ward, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; operational, not diagnostic or clinical

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
